title: Input Data and Indicator Estimates from the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme
description: Contains two data resources from the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene. `jmpraw` holds the survey-level input data on sanitation that underlies the JMP estimates, collected from the country files published on <https://washdata.org>. `jmpindicators` holds the modelled JMP indicator estimates for water, sanitation and hygiene from the JMP world file. Both datasets are packaged from the JMP 2025 release.
keywords: water, sanitation, hygiene, WASH, JMP, SDG6, open data
geographicDescription: Global; countries, areas and territories covered by the WHO/UNICEF JMP
